chunks: Masʿadah ibn Ṣadaqah al-Rabaʿī narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “The bequest completes what is deficient in zakat.”

key_terms.الزَّكَاةِ: The obligatory alms-tax due on qualifying wealth
key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةُ: A bequest or will made concerning one’s property after death
key_terms.تَمَامُ: Completion or making whole what is lacking

ai.seo_question: How can a bequest relate to deficiencies in zakat?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a bequest serves to complete what may have fallen short in one's zakat. It links end-of-life financial duty with accountability before Allah, emphasizing the importance of addressing deficiencies in obligatory alms.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5413 - Masadah ibn Sadaqah Al-Rabii narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Making a will completes what is lacking from the payment of zakat."
